Thanks Marissa — taking this on. Notes / initial answers:

- PHI: Our default hosting model does not require storage of PHI in the model weights or inferences; customers can send PHI in calls. For Acme Health, we recommend a Private deployment or dedicated tenancy if they want strict PHI isolation. We do support encrypted-at-rest for S3 and DB layers; we do not persist raw clinician notes in our analytics pipeline by default (configurable).
- Systems in scope (recommended): clinician webapp backend (API layer), embeddings store (managed S3 + vector DB), session cache (Redis), analytics pipeline (ETL that may ingest events).
- Docs we can provide for kickoff: SOC 2 report summary, redwood-security-pack.pdf (includes network diagram, encryption/KMS details, incident response summary), TLS & cert rotation notes.
- Open items for Acme: whether they require on-prem/private deployment, and whether they consider embeddings content PHI under their policy.

I'll start filling the questionnaire and aim to send a draft back by EOD Mon. Can we propose Tue 10:30 PT for the kickoff?

-Dylan
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
